rows.quote: [Table] REAGENT or RESOURCE: Breast Cancer Association Consortium (BCAC) OncoArray GWAS summary statistics | SOURCE: Zhang et al.31 | IDENTIFIER: https://doi.org/10.1038/s41588-020-0609-2
rows.dataset_named_in_source: Breast Cancer Association Consortium (BCAC) OncoArray GWAS summary statistics
rows.coder_note: The paper uses the BCAC OncoArray and BCAC iCOGS summary statistics of Zhang 2020 as two separate outcome datasets and meta-analyses them itself. The three dictionary rows of that DOI are the combined overall meta-analysis, the two-stage subtype model and the CIMBA meta-analysis; none is an OncoArray-only or iCOGS-only dataset, and no sentence carries an attribute that selects one of them (rule E). The case and control totals are written as approximate.

rows.quote: FinnGen cohort: The FinnGen R9 release includes genetic and health data from Finnish biobank participants.
rows.coder_note: "FinnGen R9 release" names release 9; the key resources table and the acknowledgments also write R9. The breast cancer case and control counts are endpoint-specific (rule H).

rows.quote: [Table] REAGENT or RESOURCE: DeCODE genetics plasma protein QTL summary statistics | SOURCE: Ferkingstad et al.28 | IDENTIFIER: https://doi.org/10.1038/s41588-021-00978-w
rows.coder_note: The table row gives DOI 10.1038/s41588-021-00978-w for the deCODE pQTL statistics, the source identifier of the Ferkingstad 2021 row only. The data availability sentence agrees: 35,559 individuals, 4,907 aptamers via SomaScan.

The UKBPPP data are attributed to Sun 2023 (DOI 10.1038/s41586-023-06592-6), a source with four dictionary rows. The sentences carrying the citation give 54,219 individuals and the Olink platform, and 54,219 is the N of no row; "European ancestry" appears only in an uncited sentence with the same 54,219. No single sentence holds the citation with an attribute that selects one row (rule E).
